retrospective_noncausal_per_report_broad.interpretation: Assign the window label backward to every consumed report; descriptive classification only, never a causal alarm.

results.physical_source_reason: Broadcast Event annotations do not identify a physical source.

truth_uncertainty.note: Long E3/E4 support may include multiple interventions or settled/recovery states. Do not turn these runs into precise actuation episodes or physical source truth.

limitations: One previously exposed RAW record; report and window counts are not independent test draws.
